howToPlay: Use your Super to manipulate projectile speeds in a key area to control the battlefield. Combine this with your main attack to debuff enemies or use gadgets to reposition or freeze them in place.
gears: Equip DAMAGE to increase your damage output, HEALTH to recover quickly, and GADGET COOLDOWN to use your special abilities more frequently.
trait: This brawler suits a strategic player who enjoys controlling the flow of combat through spatial manipulation and timing.
